using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Hashbrown.AspNetCore;

static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message); }
static string Frame(object item) => "data: " + System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(item) + "\r\n\r\n";
static string Input() => """{"threadId":"thread","runId":"run","messages":[{"id":"user","role":"user","content":"Hello"}],"tools":[],"context":[],"state":{},"forwardedProps":{}}""";
static string Terminal() => Frame(new { type = "RUN_FINISHED", threadId = "thread", runId = "run" });
static string Call(string id, string name, string? parent = null) => Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_START", toolCallId = id, toolCallName = name, parentMessageId = parent }) + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_ARGS", toolCallId = id, delta = "{}" }) + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_END", toolCallId = id });
static NativeSessionProjection Projection(int bytes = 65536, int frame = 16384, int terminal = 4096) => new(Input(), new HashSet<string>(["browser"], StringComparer.Ordinal), bytes, 100, frame, terminal);
static async Task<(NativeSessionProjection Projection, string Forwarded)> Observe(string wire, bool split = false)
{
    var projection = Projection();
    var forwarded = new MemoryStream();
    var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(wire);

    if (split) foreach (var value in bytes) await projection.ObserveAsync(new byte[] { value }, chunk => forwarded.WriteAsync(chunk), default);
    else await projection.ObserveAsync(bytes, chunk => forwarded.WriteAsync(chunk), default);
    projection.Complete();

    return (projection, Encoding.UTF8.GetString(forwarded.ToArray()));
}

var text = Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_START", messageId = "answer", role = "assistant" }) + Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT", messageId = "answer", delta = "Hello 🌎" }) + Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_END", messageId = "answer" });
var observed = await Observe(text + Terminal(), true);

Check(observed.Forwarded == text, "Ordinary bytes must stream while genuine terminal is held, even at every UTF-8 boundary.");
Check(observed.Projection.Result.Available && observed.Projection.Result.TurnCompleted, "Complete text must produce canonical available history.");
Check(JsonNode.Parse(observed.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["content"]!.GetValue<string>() == "Hello 🌎", "Canonical streamed text differs.");
var released = new MemoryStream();
await observed.Projection.ReleaseTerminalAsync(chunk => released.WriteAsync(chunk), default);
Check(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(released.ToArray()) == Terminal(), "Release must preserve exact genuine terminal bytes.");
try { await observed.Projection.ReleaseTerminalAsync(chunk => released.WriteAsync(chunk), default); throw new Exception("Duplicate release accepted."); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { }

var pending = await Observe(Call("client", "browser") + Terminal());

Check(pending.Projection.Result.Available && !pending.Projection.Result.TurnCompleted, "Unanswered public browser call should remain continuable.");
Check(pending.Projection.Result.ExpectedBrowserCallIds.SequenceEqual(new[] { "client" }), "Browser call IDs differ.");
Check(JsonNode.Parse(pending.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["id"]!.GetValue<string>() == "assistant-client", "Missing parent must match SDK deterministic fallback.");
Check(JsonNode.Parse(pending.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["content"]!.GetValue<string>() == "", "SDK tool assistant starts with empty content.");

var mixed = await Observe(Call("client", "browser", "siblings") + Call("server", "backend", "siblings") + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "server", messageId = "server-result", content = "actual" }) + Terminal());

Check(mixed.Projection.Result.Available && mixed.Projection.Result.ExpectedBrowserCallIds.SequenceEqual(new[] { "client" }), "Actual server result and public browser sibling must fold.");
Check(JsonNode.Parse(mixed.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["toolCalls"]!.AsArray().Count == 2, "Native parent grouping differs.");

foreach (var (name, wire) in new (string, string)[] {
    ("unanswered server", Call("server", "backend") + Terminal()),
    ("unknown event", Frame(new { type = "CUSTOM", name = "unknown", value = new {} }) + Terminal()),
    ("reasoning", Frame(new { type = "REASONING_MESSAGE_START", messageId = "reason" }) + Terminal()),
    ("metadata", Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_START", messageId = "answer", role = "assistant", metadata = new { meaningful = true } }) + Terminal()),
    ("incomplete text", Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_START", messageId = "answer", role = "assistant" }) + Terminal()),
    ("duplicate call", Call("client", "browser") + Call("client", "browser") + Terminal()),
    ("duplicate result", Call("server", "backend") + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "server", messageId = "result", content = "actual" }) + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "server", messageId = "other-result", content = "actual" }) + Terminal()),
    ("unknown result", Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "forged", messageId = "result", content = "forged" }) + Terminal()),
    ("native approval", Frame(new { type = "RUN_FINISHED", threadId = "thread", runId = "run", outcome = new { type = "interrupt", interrupts = new[] { new { id = "approval", type = "approval" } } } })),
    ("malformed arguments", Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_START", toolCallId = "client", toolCallName = "browser" }) + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_ARGS", toolCallId = "client", delta = "bad-json" }) + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_END", toolCallId = "client" }) + Terminal()),
}) {
    var result = await Observe(wire);

    Check(!result.Projection.Result.Available && result.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson is null, name + " must fail closed.");
    Check(!result.Forwarded.Contains("RUN_FINISHED", StringComparison.Ordinal), name + " leaked terminal.");
}

foreach (var (name, bytes) in new (string, byte[])[] {
    ("duplicate terminal", Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Terminal() + Terminal())),
    ("event after terminal", Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Terminal() + text)),
    ("identity mismatch", Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Frame(new { type = "RUN_FINISHED", threadId = "other", runId = "run" }))),
    ("invalid UTF8", new byte[] { 100,97,116,97,58,32,255,10,10 }),
    ("malformed JSON", Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("data: {oops}\n\n")),
}) {
    var projection = Projection();
    var rejected = false;

    try { await projection.ObserveAsync(bytes, _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default); projection.Complete(); } catch (Exception exception) when (exception is InvalidOperationException or IOException or System.Text.Json.JsonException) { rejected = true; }

    Check(rejected && !projection.Result.Available, name + " must reject framing/identity.");
}

foreach (var (name, projection, wire) in new[] {
    ("frame", Projection(frame: 128), Frame(new { type = "CUSTOM", name = new string('x', 256) })),
    ("terminal", Projection(terminal: 128), Frame(new { type = "RUN_FINISHED", threadId = "thread", runId = "run", result = new string('x', 256) })),
}) {
    var rejected = false;

    try { await projection.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(wire), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default); } catch (IOException) { rejected = true; }

    Check(rejected && !projection.Result.Available, name + " bound must reject before publication.");
}

var errorWire = Frame(new { type = "RUN_ERROR", message = "Actual upstream error", code = "native" });
var failed = await Observe(errorWire);

Check(failed.Forwarded == "" && failed.Projection.Result.TerminalType == "RUN_ERROR" && !failed.Projection.Result.TurnCompleted, "Genuine native failure must be held and identified.");

var annotations = await Observe(Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_START", messageId = "answer", role = "assistant", annotations = new[] { new { type = "citation" } } }) + Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_END", messageId = "answer" }) + Terminal());

Check(!annotations.Projection.Result.Available, "Unrepresentable event annotations must make history unavailable.");

var wrongError = Projection();
var errorRejected = false;

try { await wrongError.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Frame(new { type = "RUN_ERROR", message = "failure", threadId = "other", runId = "run" })), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { errorRejected = true; }

Check(errorRejected, "Error terminal must not carry another request identity.");


static JsonObject RawCall(bool anonymous = false) => new()
{
    ["authorName"] = "Native", ["role"] = "assistant", ["messageId"] = anonymous ? null : "parent", ["responseId"] = anonymous ? "response-native" : "parent",
    ["finishReason"] = anonymous ? null : "tool_calls", ["modelId"] = "native-model", ["createdAt"] = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    ["contents"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["$type"] = "functionCall", ["name"] = "browser", ["arguments"] = new JsonObject { ["code"] = "PDX" }, ["informationalOnly"] = false, ["callId"] = "raw-call" })
};
static string RawCallWire(JsonObject raw, bool anonymous = false, string args = "{\"code\":\"PDX\"}") =>
    Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_START", ["toolCallId"] = "raw-call", ["toolCallName"] = "browser", ["parentMessageId"] = anonymous ? null : "parent", ["rawEvent"] = raw.DeepClone() }) +
    Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_ARGS", ["toolCallId"] = "raw-call", ["delta"] = args, ["rawEvent"] = raw.DeepClone() }) +
    Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_END", toolCallId = "raw-call" });
var witnessed = new NativeSessionProjectionEvidence((response, message) => response == "response-native" && message == "native-text", (response, call, name, args) => response == "response-native" && call == "raw-call" && name == "browser" && JsonNode.DeepEquals(args, new JsonObject { ["code"] = "PDX" }));
foreach (var anonymous in new[] { false, true })
{
    var projection = new NativeSessionProjection(Input(), new HashSet<string>(["browser"]), evidence: witnessed);
    var raw = RawCall(anonymous);

    await projection.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(RawCallWire(raw, anonymous) + Terminal()), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
    projection.Complete();

    Check(projection.Result.Available, "Exact redundant raw call diagnostics require native evidence only for provider identity aliases.");
    Check(JsonNode.Parse(projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["id"]!.GetValue<string>() == (anonymous ? "assistant-raw-call" : "parent"), "Raw diagnostics must not select canonical parent identity.");
    Check(JsonNode.Parse(projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["name"] is null, "Diagnostic authorName must not create a public name ignored by the SDK.");
}
foreach (var mismatch in new[] { "arguments", "annotations", "continuation", "unwitnessed-alias" })
{
    var raw = RawCall(mismatch == "unwitnessed-alias");
    if (mismatch == "annotations") raw["contents"]![0]!["annotations"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "citation" });
    if (mismatch == "continuation") raw["continuationToken"] = "private";
    var projection = Projection();
    var arguments = mismatch == "arguments" ? "{\"code\":\"BAD\"}" : "{\"code\":\"PDX\"}";

    await projection.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(RawCallWire(raw, mismatch == "unwitnessed-alias", arguments) + Terminal()), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
    projection.Complete();

    Check(!projection.Result.Available, "Raw " + mismatch + " must make canonical history unavailable.");
}

var wrongResultRole = await Observe(Call("server", "backend") + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "server", messageId = "server-result", content = "actual", role = "assistant" }) + Terminal());

Check(!wrongResultRole.Projection.Result.Available, "Result role must agree with canonical tool role.");

var dropped = Projection();
try { await dropped.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text), chunk => Encoding.UTF8.GetString(chunk.Span).Contains("TEXT_MESSAGE_END", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? ValueTask.FromException(new IOException("disconnected")) : ValueTask.CompletedTask, default); } catch (IOException) { }
try { await dropped.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Terminal()), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default); dropped.Complete(); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { }

Check(!dropped.Result.Available, "A failed ordinary write must prevent later successful terminal publication.");
var started = await Observe(Frame(new { type = "RUN_STARTED", threadId = "thread", runId = "run", protocolVersion = "1.0" }) + text + Terminal());

Check(started.Projection.Result.Available, "Pinned native RUN_STARTED protocolVersion must be supported.");
var malformedRaw = RawCall();
malformedRaw["modelId"] = new JsonObject { ["private"] = "meaningful" };
var malformedDiagnostic = await Observe(RawCallWire(malformedRaw) + Terminal());

Check(!malformedDiagnostic.Projection.Result.Available, "Malformed raw diagnostic types must fail closed.");
var selfParent = await Observe(Call("client", "browser", "client") + Terminal());

Check(!selfParent.Projection.Result.Available, "A tool call ID must not alias its assistant parent ID.");

var nextInput = JsonNode.Parse(pending.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!.AsObject();
nextInput["messages"]!.AsArray().Add(new JsonObject { ["id"] = "client-result", ["role"] = "tool", ["toolCallId"] = "client", ["content"] = "actual-browser-data" });
var nextProjection = new NativeSessionProjection(nextInput.ToJsonString(), new HashSet<string>(["browser"]));
var nextWire = Call("next-server", "backend") + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "next-server", messageId = "next-server-result", content = "actual-server-data" }) + text + Terminal();

await nextProjection.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(nextWire), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
nextProjection.Complete();

Check(nextProjection.Result.Available && nextProjection.Result.TurnCompleted, "A subsequent native turn must advance the current prefix.");
Check(JsonNode.Parse(nextProjection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]!.AsArray().Count == 6, "Subsequent prefix must contain each canonical input/output message once.");
Check(JsonNode.Parse(nextProjection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["toolCalls"]![0]!["id"]!.GetValue<string>() == "client", "Previously owned browser call must be retained exactly once.");

var replay = new NativeSessionProjection(nextInput.ToJsonString(), new HashSet<string>(["browser"]));

await replay.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Call("client", "browser") + Terminal()), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
replay.Complete();

Check(!replay.Result.Available, "Native output cannot duplicate a historical call ID.");

var limitedPublic = Projection(bytes: 1024);
var longText = Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_START", messageId = "long", role = "assistant" }) + string.Concat(Enumerable.Repeat(Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT", messageId = "long", delta = new string('x', 100) }), 12)) + Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_END", messageId = "long" }) + Terminal();

await limitedPublic.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(longText), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
limitedPublic.Complete();

Check(!limitedPublic.Result.Available && limitedPublic.Result.PublicRequestJson is null, "Canonical public-history byte bound must discard retained content.");

var limitedMessages = new NativeSessionProjection(Input(), new HashSet<string>(["browser"]), maximumMessages: 1);

await limitedMessages.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text + Terminal()), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
limitedMessages.Complete();

Check(!limitedMessages.Result.Available, "Canonical public-history message bound must fail closed.");

var missing = await Observe(text);

Check(!missing.Projection.Result.Available && missing.Projection.Result.TerminalType is null, "Missing terminal cannot acknowledge completion.");

var partial = Projection();
var partialRejected = false;

await partial.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Terminal()[..^2]), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
try { partial.Complete(); } catch (IOException) { partialRejected = true; }

Check(partialRejected && !partial.Result.Available, "A truncated terminal frame cannot acknowledge completion.");

var noRelease = false;
try { await selfParent.Projection.ReleaseTerminalAsync(_ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { noRelease = true; }

Check(noRelease, "Unavailable canonical history cannot publish a successful terminal.");

var multiline = "data: {\r\ndata: \"type\": \"STATE_SNAPSHOT\",\r\ndata: \"snapshot\": {\"count\": 2}\r\ndata: }\r\n\r\n";
var multiple = await Observe(": keep-alive\r\n\r\n" + multiline + text + Terminal(), true);

Check(multiple.Projection.Result.Available && JsonNode.Parse(multiple.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["state"]!["count"]!.GetValue<int>() == 2, "Multiline JSON SSE and comments must preserve supported native state.");
Check(multiple.Forwarded == ": keep-alive\r\n\r\n" + multiline + text, "Ordinary multiline/comment frames must preserve exact native bytes.");

var malformedIdentity = Projection();
try { await malformedIdentity.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Frame(new { type = "RUN_ERROR", message = "failure", threadId = 42 })), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { }
try { await malformedIdentity.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Terminal()), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default); malformedIdentity.Complete(); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { }

Check(!malformedIdentity.Result.Available, "Malformed native event failure must permanently block subsequent successful publication.");
var emptyParent = await Observe(Call("empty-parent-call", "browser", "") + Terminal());

Check(!emptyParent.Projection.Result.Available, "An explicitly empty native parent identity must not replace SDK fallback.");
var malformedErrorValue = await Observe(Call("error-result", "backend") + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "error-result", messageId = "error-message", content = "actual", error = new { unexpected = true } }) + Terminal());

Check(!malformedErrorValue.Projection.Result.Available, "An unsupported tool error value must make history unavailable.");

static async Task<JsonObject> ProjectLifecycle(string name, string original, string wire, NativeSessionProjectionEvidence? evidence = null)
{
    var projection = new NativeSessionProjection(original, new HashSet<string>(["browser"]), evidence: evidence);
    var events = new JsonArray(wire.Split("\r\n\r\n", StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Select(frame => JsonNode.Parse(frame[6..])).ToArray());

    await projection.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(wire), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
    projection.Complete();

    Check(projection.Result.Available, "SDK lifecycle projection must remain available: " + name);
    return new JsonObject { ["name"] = name, ["original"] = JsonNode.Parse(original), ["events"] = events, ["messages"] = JsonNode.Parse(projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]!.DeepClone() };
}
var lifecycleCases = new JsonArray();
var textThenCall = await ProjectLifecycle("ended text then parentless call", Input(), text + Call("after-text", "browser") + Terminal());

Check(textThenCall["messages"]!.AsArray().Count == 2 && textThenCall["messages"]![1]!["id"]!.GetValue<string>() == "answer" && textThenCall["messages"]![1]!["toolCalls"]![0]!["id"]!.GetValue<string>() == "after-text", "Parentless tool call must reuse the active assistant after TEXT_MESSAGE_END, matching the SDK.");
lifecycleCases.Add(textThenCall);
lifecycleCases.Add(await ProjectLifecycle("intervening server result retains active assistant", Input(), text + Call("intervening-server", "backend") + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "intervening-server", messageId = "intervening-result", content = "actual" }) + Call("after-result", "browser") + Terminal()));
lifecycleCases.Add(await ProjectLifecycle("explicit parent does not change active assistant", Input(), text + Call("explicit-server", "backend", "other-parent") + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "explicit-server", messageId = "explicit-result", content = "actual" }) + Call("after-explicit", "browser") + Terminal()));
lifecycleCases.Add(await ProjectLifecycle("fallback after explicit tool parent without text", Input(), Call("fallback-server", "backend", "explicit-only-parent") + Frame(new { type = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", toolCallId = "fallback-server", messageId = "fallback-result", content = "actual" }) + Call("true-fallback", "browser") + Terminal()));
lifecycleCases.Add(await ProjectLifecycle("witnessed anonymous diagnostics retain active assistant", Input(), text + RawCallWire(RawCall(true), true) + Terminal(), witnessed));
var subsequentInput = JsonNode.Parse(Input())!.AsObject();
subsequentInput["runId"] = "next-run";
subsequentInput["messages"] = textThenCall["messages"]!.DeepClone();
subsequentInput["messages"]!.AsArray().Add(new JsonObject { ["id"] = "after-text-result", ["role"] = "tool", ["toolCallId"] = "after-text", ["content"] = "actual-browser" });
lifecycleCases.Add(await ProjectLifecycle("subsequent attempt does not inherit previous assistant", subsequentInput.ToJsonString(), Frame(new { type = "RUN_STARTED", threadId = "thread", runId = "next-run", protocolVersion = "1.0" }) + Call("next-run-call", "browser") + Frame(new { type = "RUN_FINISHED", threadId = "thread", runId = "next-run" })));



static JsonObject SharedTextRaw(string responseId = "message-1", string messageId = "message-1") => new()
{
    ["authorName"] = "native", ["role"] = "assistant", ["contents"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["$type"] = "text", ["text"] = "done", ["annotations"] = null, ["additionalProperties"] = null }),
    ["additionalProperties"] = null, ["responseId"] = responseId, ["messageId"] = messageId, ["conversationId"] = null,
    ["createdAt"] = null, ["finishReason"] = null, ["modelId"] = null, ["continuationToken"] = null,
};
static string SharedTextWire(JsonObject raw, string delta = "done", JsonObject? contentRaw = null, bool includeContentRaw = true) =>
    Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TEXT_MESSAGE_START", ["messageId"] = "message-1", ["role"] = "assistant", ["name"] = "native", ["rawEvent"] = raw.DeepClone() }) +
    Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT", ["messageId"] = "message-1", ["delta"] = delta, ["rawEvent"] = includeContentRaw ? (contentRaw ?? raw).DeepClone() : null }) +
    Frame(new { type = "TEXT_MESSAGE_END", messageId = "message-1" });
var sharedText = await Observe(SharedTextWire(SharedTextRaw()) + Terminal());

Check(sharedText.Projection.Result.Available, "Actual pinned native shared nonempty START/CONTENT diagnostics with identical canonical IDs must be representable without alias evidence.");
Check(JsonNode.Parse(sharedText.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["content"]!.GetValue<string>() == "done", "Shared raw START must not duplicate canonical text.");
Check(JsonNode.Parse(sharedText.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]![1]!["name"]!.GetValue<string>() == "native", "Public text name must come from the canonical START.");
var changedTextRaw = SharedTextRaw();
changedTextRaw["contents"]![0]!["text"] = "changed";
var annotatedTextRaw = SharedTextRaw();
annotatedTextRaw["contents"]![0]!["annotations"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "citation" });
foreach (var (name, wire) in new[] {
    ("canonical text mismatch", SharedTextWire(SharedTextRaw(), delta: "changed")),
    ("repeated raw mismatch", SharedTextWire(SharedTextRaw(), delta: "changed", contentRaw: changedTextRaw)),
    ("missing matching CONTENT diagnostic", SharedTextWire(SharedTextRaw(), includeContentRaw: false)),
    ("unwitnessed response alias", SharedTextWire(SharedTextRaw(responseId: "provider-response"))),
    ("different raw message identity", SharedTextWire(SharedTextRaw(messageId: "different-message"))),
    ("unsupported text annotations", SharedTextWire(annotatedTextRaw)),
})
{
    var rejectedText = await Observe(wire + Terminal());

    Check(!rejectedText.Projection.Result.Available && rejectedText.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson is null, "Shared text " + name + " must still fail closed.");
}
var textAliasEvidence = new NativeSessionProjectionEvidence((response, message) => response == "provider-response" && message == "message-1", (_, _, _, _) => false);
var witnessedTextAlias = new NativeSessionProjection(Input(), new HashSet<string>(["browser"]), evidence: textAliasEvidence);

await witnessedTextAlias.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(SharedTextWire(SharedTextRaw(responseId: "provider-response")) + Terminal()), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
witnessedTextAlias.Complete();

Check(witnessedTextAlias.Result.Available, "A distinct response alias still requires and accepts its trusted native evidence.");


static JsonObject DeferredServerRaw(string callId = "back_1", string name = "backend", string code = "PDX") => new()
{
    ["authorName"] = "native", ["role"] = "assistant", ["contents"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["$type"] = "functionCall", ["name"] = name, ["arguments"] = new JsonObject { ["code"] = code }, ["informationalOnly"] = true, ["callId"] = callId, ["annotations"] = null, ["additionalProperties"] = null }),
    ["additionalProperties"] = null, ["responseId"] = "generated-native-parent", ["messageId"] = "generated-native-parent", ["conversationId"] = null,
    ["createdAt"] = "2026-10-27T03:29:22.01008+00:00", ["finishReason"] = null, ["modelId"] = null, ["continuationToken"] = null,
};
static string DeferredServerWire(JsonObject raw)
{
    var content = raw["contents"]![0]!;
    var callId = content["callId"]!.GetValue<string>();
    var resultRaw = new JsonObject
    {
        ["authorName"] = "native", ["role"] = "tool", ["contents"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["$type"] = "functionResult", ["result"] = "server-PDX", ["callId"] = callId, ["annotations"] = null, ["additionalProperties"] = null }),
        ["additionalProperties"] = null, ["responseId"] = "generated-native-result", ["messageId"] = "generated-native-result", ["conversationId"] = null,
        ["createdAt"] = "2026-10-27T03:29:22.052563+00:00", ["finishReason"] = null, ["modelId"] = null, ["continuationToken"] = null,
    };
    return Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_START", ["toolCallId"] = callId, ["toolCallName"] = content["name"]!.DeepClone(), ["parentMessageId"] = raw["messageId"]?.DeepClone(), ["rawEvent"] = raw.DeepClone() }) +
        Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_ARGS", ["toolCallId"] = callId, ["delta"] = content["arguments"]!.ToJsonString(), ["rawEvent"] = raw.DeepClone() }) +
        Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_END", ["toolCallId"] = callId, ["rawEvent"] = raw.DeepClone() }) +
        Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", ["toolCallId"] = callId, ["messageId"] = callId, ["content"] = "\"server-PDX\"", ["rawEvent"] = resultRaw });
}
static async Task<NativeSessionProjection> ObserveDeferred(JsonObject raw, NativeSessionProjectionEvidence evidence)
{
    var projection = new NativeSessionProjection(Input(), new HashSet<string>(["browser"]), evidence: evidence);

    await projection.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(DeferredServerWire(raw) + Terminal()), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
    projection.Complete();

    return projection;
}
static bool OwnsDeferredServer(string? callId, string? name, JsonNode? arguments) => callId == "back_1" && name == "backend" && JsonNode.DeepEquals(arguments, JsonNode.Parse("{ \"code\" : \"PDX\" }"));
var ownedServerEvidence = new NativeSessionProjectionEvidence((_, _) => false, (_, _, _, _) => false, ownedCall: OwnsDeferredServer);
var deferredOwned = await ObserveDeferred(DeferredServerRaw(), ownedServerEvidence);

Check(deferredOwned.Result.Available && deferredOwned.Result.TurnCompleted, "Actual native deferred informationalOnly=true/null-finish announcement requires an exact current owned registered server-call witness.");

    ("unowned", DeferredServerRaw(), new NativeSessionProjectionEvidence((_, _) => false, (_, _, _, _) => false)),

static JsonObject ServerCallBatch(params string[] ids)
{
    var raw = DeferredServerRaw();
    raw["contents"] = new JsonArray(ids.Select(id => DeferredServerRaw(callId: id)["contents"]![0]!.DeepClone()).ToArray());
    return raw;
}
static JsonObject ServerResultBatch(params string[] ids)
{
    var raw = DeferredServerRaw();
    raw["role"] = "tool"; raw["messageId"] = "batch-result"; raw["responseId"] = "batch-result";
    raw["contents"] = new JsonArray(ids.Select(id => (JsonNode)new JsonObject { ["$type"] = "functionResult", ["callId"] = id, ["result"] = "server-PDX", ["annotations"] = null, ["additionalProperties"] = null }).ToArray());
    return raw;
}
static string ServerBatchWire(JsonObject callRaw, JsonObject resultRaw, string[]? callIds = null, string[]? resultIds = null, JsonObject? secondResultRaw = null)
{
    var wire = "";
    foreach (var id in callIds ?? ["back_1", "back_2"])
        wire += Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_START", ["toolCallId"] = id, ["toolCallName"] = "backend", ["parentMessageId"] = callRaw["messageId"]!.DeepClone(), ["rawEvent"] = callRaw.DeepClone() }) +
            Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_ARGS", ["toolCallId"] = id, ["delta"] = "{\"code\":\"PDX\"}", ["rawEvent"] = callRaw.DeepClone() }) +
            Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_END", ["toolCallId"] = id, ["rawEvent"] = callRaw.DeepClone() });
    var index = 0;
    foreach (var id in resultIds ?? ["back_1", "back_2"])
        wire += Frame(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "TOOL_CALL_RESULT", ["toolCallId"] = id, ["messageId"] = id, ["content"] = "\"server-PDX\"", ["rawEvent"] = (index++ == 1 ? secondResultRaw ?? resultRaw : resultRaw).DeepClone() });
    return wire;
}
static bool OwnsServerBatch(string? id, string? name, JsonNode? arguments) => id is "back_1" or "back_2" && name == "backend" && JsonNode.DeepEquals(arguments, JsonNode.Parse("{\"code\":\"PDX\"}"));
static async Task<(NativeSessionProjection Projection, string Forwarded)> ObserveServerBatch(string wire, NativeSessionProjectionEvidence proof, int maximumMessages = 1000, int maximumBytes = 1048576)
{
    var projection = new NativeSessionProjection(Input(), new HashSet<string>(["browser"]), maximumBytes: maximumBytes, maximumMessages: maximumMessages, evidence: proof);
    var forwarded = new MemoryStream();

    await projection.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(wire + Terminal()), chunk => forwarded.WriteAsync(chunk), default);
    projection.Complete();

    return (projection, Encoding.UTF8.GetString(forwarded.ToArray()));
}
var ownedBatchEvidence = new NativeSessionProjectionEvidence((_, _) => false, (_, _, _, _) => false, ownedCall: OwnsServerBatch);
var actualBatchWire = ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2"), ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2"));
var actualBatch = await ObserveServerBatch(actualBatchWire, ownedBatchEvidence);

Check(actualBatch.Projection.Result.Available && actualBatch.Projection.Result.TurnCompleted, "Actual native two-sibling shared call/result diagnostics require bounded exact owned obligations.");
Check(actualBatch.Forwarded == actualBatchWire, "Batch validation must preserve every ordinary frame byte and hold only the genuine terminal.");
var actualBatchMessages = JsonNode.Parse(actualBatch.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]!.AsArray();
Check(actualBatchMessages.Count == 4 && actualBatchMessages[1]!["toolCalls"]!.AsArray().Count == 2, "Raw siblings must not duplicate or synthesize canonical calls/results.");
var changedResultBatch = ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2");
changedResultBatch["contents"]![0]!["result"] = "changed";
var wrongArgumentsBatch = ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2");
wrongArgumentsBatch["contents"]![1]!["arguments"]!["code"] = "ORD";
var mixedCallBatch = ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2");
mixedCallBatch["contents"]!.AsArray().Add(new JsonObject { ["$type"] = "text", ["text"] = "extra" });

mixedResultBatch["contents"]!.AsArray().Add(DeferredServerRaw()["contents"]![0]!.DeepClone());

foreach (var member in ordinaryCallBatch["contents"]!.AsArray()) member!["informationalOnly"] = false;
ordinaryCallBatch["finishReason"] = "tool_calls";

metadataCallBatch["contents"]![1]!["annotations"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["type"] = "citation" });
var aliasCallBatch = ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2");
aliasCallBatch["responseId"] = "unwitnessed-batch-alias";
var ownsThreeServers = new NativeSessionProjectionEvidence((_, _) => false, (_, _, _, _) => false, ownedCall: (id, name, arguments) => id is "back_1" or "back_2" or "back_3" && name == "backend" && JsonNode.DeepEquals(arguments, JsonNode.Parse("{\"code\":\"PDX\"}")));
foreach (var (name, wire, proof) in new[] {
    ("missing canonical sibling call", ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2"), ServerResultBatch("back_1"), callIds: ["back_1"], resultIds: ["back_1"]), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("missing canonical sibling result", ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2"), ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2"), resultIds: ["back_1"]), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("extra owned raw-only call", ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2", "back_3"), ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2")), ownsThreeServers),
    ("unowned sibling", ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2", "back_3"), ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2")), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("provider-only batch", actualBatchWire, providerOnlyEvidence),
    ("changed sibling arguments", ServerBatchWire(wrongArgumentsBatch, ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2")), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("changed repeated sibling result", ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2"), ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2"), secondResultRaw: changedResultBatch), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("duplicate raw call IDs", ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_1"), ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2")), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("duplicate raw result IDs", ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2"), ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_1")), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("heterogeneous call batch", ServerBatchWire(mixedCallBatch, ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2")), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("heterogeneous result batch", ServerBatchWire(ServerCallBatch("back_1", "back_2"), mixedResultBatch), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("ordinary false batch remains unsupported", ServerBatchWire(ordinaryCallBatch, ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2")), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("unknown sibling metadata", ServerBatchWire(metadataCallBatch, ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2")), ownedBatchEvidence),
    ("unwitnessed batch alias", ServerBatchWire(aliasCallBatch, ServerResultBatch("back_1", "back_2")), ownedBatchEvidence),
})
{
    var rejectedBatch = await ObserveServerBatch(wire, proof);

    Check(!rejectedBatch.Projection.Result.Available && rejectedBatch.Projection.Result.PublicRequestJson is null, "Batch " + name + " must fail closed.");

var boundedBatch = await ObserveServerBatch(actualBatchWire, ownedBatchEvidence, maximumMessages: 1);

static string RewriteBatchEvents(string wire, Action<JsonObject> edit) => string.Concat(wire.Split("\r\n\r\n", StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Select(frame =>
{
    var item = JsonNode.Parse(frame[6..])!.AsObject();
    edit(item);
    return Frame(item);
}));
var changedCanonicalResult = RewriteBatchEvents(actualBatchWire, item =>
{
    if (item["type"]!.GetValue<string>() == "TOOL_CALL_RESULT" && item["toolCallId"]!.GetValue<string>() == "back_2")
    { item.Remove("rawEvent"); item["content"] = "\"changed\""; }
});
var changedCanonicalArguments = RewriteBatchEvents(actualBatchWire, item =>
{
    if (item["toolCallId"]!.GetValue<string>() == "back_2" || item["type"]!.GetValue<string>() == "TOOL_CALL_RESULT") item.Remove("rawEvent");
    if (item["type"]!.GetValue<string>() == "TOOL_CALL_ARGS" && item["toolCallId"]!.GetValue<string>() == "back_2") item["delta"] = "{\"code\":\"ORD\"}";
});
foreach (var wire in new[] { changedCanonicalResult, changedCanonicalArguments })
{
    var bypass = await ObserveServerBatch(wire, ownedBatchEvidence);

    Check(!bypass.Projection.Result.Available, "Later canonical events without raw diagnostics must still resolve every retained sibling obligation exactly.");
}

{

});

    if (mutation == "missing-result") events.RemoveAt(1);
    if (mutation == "duplicate-result") events.Insert(1, events[0].DeepClone().AsObject());
    var projection = new NativeSessionProjection(original.ToJsonString(), new HashSet<string>(), evidence: new NativeSessionProjectionEvidence((_, _) => false, (_, _, _, _) => false, approvals: () => witnesses));

    await projection.ObserveAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(string.Concat(events.Select(Frame))), _ => ValueTask.CompletedTask, default);
    projection.Complete();

    Check(projection.Result.Available == (mutation == "valid"), "Only current exactly bound admitted historical results may fold from genuine raw single/batch diagnostics: " + mutation);
    if (mutation == "valid") Check(projection.Result.TurnCompleted && JsonNode.Parse(projection.Result.PublicRequestJson!)!["messages"]!.AsArray().Count == 7, "Native results with different raw/public IDs must add exactly one result per original call.");
}

Console.WriteLine("Native session projection passed.");
